rules.isobmff:error: Outcome equals the manifest expectation (manifest expect=ok)
rules.isobmff:errorCode: null exactly when error is null, and equal to the code column of the manifest, which every row that expects an error names
rules.isobmff:layout: Equal to the layout of an independent top-level scan: mvex, the first mdat against the moov, a sidx before the first moof, the moov sample counts
rules.isobmff:trackSelection: Same real video tracks and primary track as ffprobe (attached_pic excluded; MP4/MOV: enabled tracks only)
rules.isobmff:formatDurationSec: format.duration within 1e-6 s; skipped when subtitle or data tracks exist
rules.isobmff:avgFps: avgFpsFfprobe (the duration-sum rational) must equal avg_frame_rate exactly
rules.isobmff:avgFps.measured: Presented average (presented frames / presentation span) must equal avgFromPts within 1e-9 relative; within-tol when the frames match and the spans differ by less than one median frame delta (ffprobe filled the last packet duration)
rules.isobmff:nominalFps: Exact vs r_frame_rate, only when the track is CFR (stage 1); otherwise skipped
rules.isobmff:frames: Exact vs nb_frames (non-fragmented); fragmented: vs nb_read_packets; hybrid: total vs nb_read_packets
rules.isobmff:durationSec: Exact vs duration_ts x time_base; fragmented with sidx: within max(1 frame, abs(start_time))
rules.isobmff:minFps: Exact rational vs the tail-excluded reference minimum
rules.isobmff:maxFps: Exact rational vs the tail-excluded reference maximum
rules.isobmff:isVfr: Equal to the reference VFR flag (shared rule, tolerance max(1 tick, 0.5% of the median delta))
rules.isobmff:duplicateTimestamps: Equal to the reference count of deltas that are 0 or less
rules.isobmff:medianFrameInterval: Equal rational vs medianDeltaTicks x time_base on exact scans, within-tol when fewer than 2 deltas remain after the tail and the app kept the tail, which the reference never keeps, and n/a for probe and header scans
rules.isobmff:enabled: Equal to the tkhd enabled flag (MP4 and MOV) or FlagEnabled (Matroska) of an independent scan. ffprobe disposition.default is shown for information
rules.matroska:error: Outcome equals the manifest expectation (manifest expect=ok)
rules.matroska:errorCode: null exactly when error is null, and equal to the code column of the manifest, which every row that expects an error names
rules.matroska:layout: Equal to the layout of an independent top-level scan: mvex, the first mdat against the moov, a sidx before the first moof, the moov sample counts
rules.matroska:trackSelection: Same real video tracks and primary track as ffprobe (attached_pic excluded; MP4/MOV: enabled tracks only)
rules.matroska:formatDurationSec: Exact vs format.duration when Info Duration exists; ffprobe N/A is not compared
rules.matroska:avgFps.declared: avgFpsFfprobe must equal avg_frame_rate exactly: the declared rate when DefaultDuration exists, else the estimate ffprobe makes from the first packets (n/a only in header mode, which reads no blocks)
rules.matroska:avgFps.measured: Measured average must equal avgFromPts (integer-ms last duration) within 1e-9 relative; within-tol, as a definition difference by design, when the file stores no duration for the last frame (no DefaultDuration, no BlockDuration) and the average is exactly the frames over the timestamp span plus one median frame delta: avgFps gives that frame the median interval, ffprobe its own estimate, and ffprobe parity is avgFpsFfprobe
rules.matroska:nominalFps: rFpsFfprobe must equal r_frame_rate exactly: the declared rate when DefaultDuration exists, else the estimate ffprobe makes from the first packets (n/a in header mode, which reads no blocks)
rules.matroska:frames: Exact vs nb_read_packets (ffprobe prints nb_frames N/A)
rules.matroska:presentedFrames: Exact vs nb_read_frames (equals the block count)
rules.matroska:durationSec: ffprobe prints no duration for Matroska video streams; the DURATION tag is shown for information only
rules.matroska:startSec: Exact vs start_pts x time_base once every block timestamp has been read (exact scan); otherwise skipped
rules.matroska:minFps: Exact rational vs the tail-excluded reference minimum
rules.matroska:maxFps: Exact rational vs the tail-excluded reference maximum
rules.matroska:isVfr: Equal to the reference VFR flag (shared rule, tolerance max(1 tick, 0.5% of the median delta))
rules.matroska:duplicateTimestamps: Equal to the reference count of deltas that are 0 or less
rules.matroska:medianFrameInterval: Equal rational vs medianDeltaTicks x time_base on exact scans, within-tol when fewer than 2 deltas remain after the tail and the app kept the tail, which the reference never keeps, and n/a for probe and header scans
rules.matroska:enabled: Equal to the tkhd enabled flag (MP4 and MOV) or FlagEnabled (Matroska) of an independent scan. ffprobe disposition.default is shown for information
